name: Towngas China Company Limited
summary: Towngas China Company Limited, an investment holding company, sells and distributes piped gas in the People's Republic of China. The company operates through two segments, Sales and Distribution of Piped Gas and Related Products, and Gas Connection. It engages in the provision of piped gas; construction of gas pipelines; operation of city gas pipeline network; operation of gas fuel automobile refilling stations; and sale of gas household appliances. The company also offers financing services; provides engineering works services; and operates vehicle gas refilling stations. It serves approximately 14.14 million customers. The company was formerly known as Panva Gas Holdings Limited and changed its name to Towngas China Company Limited in May 2007. The company was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in North Point, Hong Kong. Towngas China Company Limited is a subsidiary of The Hong Kong and China Gas Company Limited.
